brief:
Resistance committees in Palestine said an Israeli strike on a municipal police headquarters in Gaza City killed Palestinian police personnel and civilians, according to Shehab Wire. The committees characterized the operation as a war crime and added it to their documented record of Israeli offenses.

The attack targeted the civil police facility in the coastal enclave. Palestinian police officers stationed at the headquarters were among those killed, along with a number of residents in the area. The committees said the strike demonstrated Israel's rejection of ceasefire obligations and represented a new violation in an escalating pattern of violence.
